A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VideoAutoArena/VideoAutoBench research work. All 25 pages, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E, support reliable comparison; the appendix text and rendered pages are identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 11 multimodal models, 12,479 model battles, human preference studies, and VideoAutoBench results in Sections 3.5 and 4.

after.justification: v2 retains those original model evaluations, human preference studies, benchmark scores, and appendix case studies.

M1.justification: The user simulation, peer battles, fault-driven evolution, automated judging, ranking, and VideoAutoBench procedures are unchanged. Appendix A retains identical operational prompts.

E1.justification: Both versions use 2,881 LongVideoBench videos across ten categories and four duration ranges. The VideoAutoBench subset remains 255 samples covering 244 videos, with no added tasks or scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the same 11 evaluated models. The question-style comparisons against VideoMME and LongVideoBench, and the individual-judge and voting comparisons in Figure 6, also retain identical participants.

E3.justification: Frame sampling, subtitle inputs, model configurations, scoring rules, and annotation procedures match. Both retain the 120-question ranking study and approximately 300 human-annotated battles; Appendix B settings are identical.

E4.justification: Both retain the same persona-diversity analysis, question-style study, difficulty and evolution comparisons, duration and judging-criterion breakdowns, and response case studies. Appendix E's style-control analysis is also unchanged.

E5.justification: The Bradley–Terry estimation procedure and statistical reporting are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Experimental values, rankings, and qualitative findings match throughout. For example, GPT-4o retains 1505.69 ELO in Table 2, 82.55 average score in Table 3, and 87.29% judging agreement in Figure 6.

T1.justification: Section 3.4 retains the same ELO probability and update equations, Bradley–Terry formulation, and treatment of ties. No mathematical definitions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning automated user-centric evaluation, fault-driven question evolution, VideoAutoBench, and performance gaps between proprietary and open-source models.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and Appendix E limitations are identical, including absent multi-turn and non-English evaluation, judges' preference for detailed responses, and shortcomings of the tested style-control approach.

D1.justification: The prompts, model identifiers, frame dimensions, token limits, temperature settings, and annotation guidelines in Appendices A–D are unchanged. Both versions provide the same project-page link.

R1.justification: The same 78 references and research positioning are retained. Table 1 changes the paper's own venue from '-' to 'CVPR 25', which updates publication metadata without changing its relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 updates author affiliations and their markers, removes the Rhymes AI internship footnote, and clarifies the introduction's 'Nov. 14' date as 'Nov. 14, 2024'. Scientific prose and section ordering remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation block shifts Figure 1 and causes text reflow, including the abstract ending on page 2 and the conclusion ending on page 9. Figures and table structures are retained; Table 1's venue cell is updated, and appendix layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 updates affiliations, publication metadata, and a date while introducing minor pagination changes. The scientific explanations, evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
